name: ezcap-extension
description: ezcap browser extension (Chromium and Firefox builds) — local, metadata-only browser network observability.

scripts.build:chromium: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit false && node build.mjs chromium
scripts.build:firefox: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit false && node build.mjs firefox
scripts.build: npm run build:chromium && npm run build:firefox
